MISSION: Build the first real physical test article to learn whether the R4.1 concept functions as intended; never treat design intent as measured success or failure.

P0_IDENTITY.name: P0
P0_IDENTITY.r4_1_role: independently testable physical derivative; not R4.2 and not a mutation of R4.1
P0_IDENTITY.primary_loop: BUILD → TEST → MEASURE → LEARN → MODIFY → RETEST

prohibited_conclusions: design failure without specified physical/calculated criterion
crash safety claim from P0 bench tests
occupant protection claim without qualified occupant testing

GATE_MODEL.GATE_1: P0 exploratory build can be safely fabricated, assembled, modified and instrumented.
GATE_MODEL.GATE_2: P0 tests can produce valid physical evidence.
GATE_MODEL.GATE_3: Design requirements are validated by evidence. P0 is currently focused on Gate 1 → Gate 2.
GATE_MODEL.rule: Gate 3 failure cannot retroactively invalidate Gate 1 or Gate 2; it drives iteration.

source_warnings: generated visuals are not verified CAD
source-study numbers are not T-OCS measurements
concept stroke/force values are not measured absorber performance

FIRST_PHYSICAL_ARTICLE.non_human: No human occupant during initial P0 program. Any ATD/sled stage requires separate authorization after subsystem evidence.

MODULAR_ARCHITECTURE.principle: TEST ONE VARIABLE AT A TIME when causality is the objective.
adjustable_interfaces: safe stop locations where changing them does not invalidate the hypothesis
sacrificial_components: experimental link or lock components where failure is expected and containment is adequate

COMPONENTS.name: Vehicle/test-fixture interface base frame
COMPONENTS.role: Anchors the P0 mechanism to a controlled bench or sled fixture and provides repeatable datum retention.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Welded/bolted fixture with replaceable interface plates; exact R4.1 hardpoint pattern is not assumed.

COMPONENTS.name: Left longitudinal rail/load path S1
COMPONENTS.role: Guided longitudinal load path for the carriage.
COMPONENTS.design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED until native CAD geometry is extracted
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Prototype rail using source geometry envelope; critical bore/axis coordinates from native CAD when exact replication is required.

COMPONENTS.name: Right longitudinal rail/load path S2
COMPONENTS.role: Second bilateral longitudinal load path for load sharing/torsional control.
COMPONENTS.design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED until native CAD geometry is extracted
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Independent mirror/companion rail with separately measurable reaction path.

COMPONENTS.name: Seat carriage
COMPONENTS.role: Moving member translating on 110L/110R and carrying seat/absorber reactions.
COMPONENTS.design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED / experimentally strengthened where needed for instrumentation
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Modular plate/frame with bolt-on absorber, lock and rail interfaces.

COMPONENTS.name: Ride-down energy-management cartridge interface
COMPONENTS.role: Allows interchangeable energy absorber configurations without changing the structural surrounding architecture.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Common clevis/pin interface; cartridge itself is a replaceable test article.

COMPONENTS.name: Pelvic-control / anti-submarining pan
COMPONENTS.role: Carries the pelvic guidance/load-distribution geometry used in integrated mechanism studies.
COMPONENTS.design_status: R4.1-SIMPLIFIED if required for bench article
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Bolt-on pan to avoid destructive revision after first test.

COMPONENTS.name: Left seatback rotation-control link
COMPONENTS.role: Independent mechanical rotation-control path on the left side.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Replaceable link with selectable hole/adapter positions only where those positions remain within safe mechanism envelope.

COMPONENTS.name: Right seatback rotation-control link
COMPONENTS.role: Independent mechanical rotation-control path on the right side.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Independent counterpart to 150L; left/right loads measured separately where practical.

COMPONENTS.name: Seatback frame
COMPONENTS.role: Carries torso/head support geometry and the independent rotation-control interfaces.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Rigid test frame with replaceable local brackets for 150L/150R and 170/180 as applicable.

COMPONENTS.name: Multi-state lock/trigger module
COMPONENTS.role: Tests the mechanical state transition architecture: normal, armed/capture, ride-down, rebound-control, secure/end state as applicable to the embodiment.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Modular lock body with replaceable locking/trigger internals and state sensor target.

COMPONENTS.name: Rebound-control module
COMPONENTS.role: Controls reverse carriage motion after primary travel.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Interchangeable directional-damping or mechanical-control cartridge/stop embodiment.

COMPONENTS.name: Occupant-restraint interface test mount
COMPONENTS.role: Preserves the restraint load-path interface for non-human bench/sled studies without making a production anchorage claim.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Qualified test anchor hardware or vehicle-equivalent fixture only; no improvised occupant restraint attachment.

COMPONENTS.name: Torso/head guidance test geometry
COMPONENTS.role: Provides modular non-occupant surrogate/guide surfaces where trajectory interaction must be studied.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Interchangeable rigid/compliant guide plates or surrogate interface; no human-contact use.

COMPONENTS.name: Sensor/trigger interface panel
COMPONENTS.role: Carries fixed sensor datums, connector routing, trigger targets and synchronization hardware.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Rigid panel isolated from intended moving DOFs; strain-relieved harnesses.

COMPONENTS.name: Hinge/pivot/bushing/fastener set
COMPONENTS.role: Creates controlled joint interfaces whose compliance, friction and preload effects can be characterized.
COMPONENTS.fabrication: Replaceable pins/bushings/washers/fasteners with traceable lot and preload method.

INSTRUMENTATION.sensor: Linear displacement transducer or optical/laser displacement system
INSTRUMENTATION.location: Carriage relative to fixed rail/base datum
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: P0 longitudinal +X axis defined from rail travel direction
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Select full-scale range > maximum safe bench stroke; resolution sufficient to resolve smallest planned variant difference; exact range set after measured/fixture envelope survey
INSTRUMENTATION.sampling: Quasi-static >=1 kS/s; dynamic >=20 kS/s unless the validated signal bandwidth requires higher
INSTRUMENTATION.calibration: Traceable calibration before campaign; zero/span check every test day
INSTRUMENTATION.uncertainty: Document full measurement uncertainty budget; propagate to velocity/energy where derived
INSTRUMENTATION.raw: CSV with UTC/local test timestamp, channel ID, units, calibration ID

INSTRUMENTATION.sensor: Load cell or instrumented load path
INSTRUMENTATION.location: Left rail/base interface or in-line reaction path
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: +X longitudinal force sign positive in forward travel direction
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Full scale above verified structural test envelope with overload protection
INSTRUMENTATION.sampling: >=20 kS/s for controlled dynamic tests; lower may be used for quasi-static
INSTRUMENTATION.calibration: Traceable force calibration; shunt/zero check as applicable
INSTRUMENTATION.uncertainty: Report calibrated force uncertainty and installation compliance

INSTRUMENTATION.sensor: Load cell or instrumented load path
INSTRUMENTATION.uncertainty: Report independently so load asymmetry can be computed

INSTRUMENTATION.sensor: In-line force transducer or instrumented actuator/load frame
INSTRUMENTATION.location: Coaxial with 130 cartridge on each tested side
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: Force positive in absorber compression/loading direction defined by cartridge datum
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Range shall exceed verified design-reference force envelope; do not use 18-22 or 25-35 kN as guaranteed test values
INSTRUMENTATION.uncertainty: Include force cell, alignment, fixture compliance and DAQ uncertainty

INSTRUMENTATION.sensor: Rotary encoder/angular transducer or calibrated inertial angle system
INSTRUMENTATION.location: Seatback frame relative to carriage/base reference
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: Positive rotation direction defined by right-hand rule about seatback hinge axis
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Range shall cover full safe P0 envelope with mechanical over-travel protection
INSTRUMENTATION.calibration: Angular zero and scale verification before each test block

INSTRUMENTATION.location: Rigid carriage mass/fixture datum near reference CG of moving assembly
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: Axes co-located/aligned to P0 frame as surveyed
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Range selected from pre-test measured dynamic envelope with overload margin; no crash-pulse assumption
INSTRUMENTATION.sampling: >=20 kS/s minimum, higher if validated bandwidth requires
INSTRUMENTATION.uncertainty: Include mounting resonance/axis misalignment in uncertainty discussion

INSTRUMENTATION.frame: Local joint coordinate system tied to P0 datums
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Chosen to resolve measured elastic/clearance range

INSTRUMENTATION.sensor: Discrete state switch/encoder/proximity target + high-speed video
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: State is categorical, synchronized to global DAQ time base
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: State transition faster than required identification bandwidth

INSTRUMENTATION.location: Representative absorber body and/or fluid/ambient points permitted by supplier
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: Temperature channels are scalar with location metadata
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Range covers qualified lab conditions; exact bounds per absorber supplier test capability
INSTRUMENTATION.sampling: >=100 S/s during transients; slower soak logging acceptable

INSTRUMENTATION.location: Side and/or rear view with whole mechanism and target joints visible
INSTRUMENTATION.frame: Camera calibration transforms to P0 coordinates
INSTRUMENTATION.rate_basis: Frame rate selected from measured motion frequency so event transition/stroke/rotation are temporally resolved
INSTRUMENTATION.sampling: >=1000 fps only as an initial planning floor; final rate determined from pre-test motion measurement and shutter/lighting requirements
INSTRUMENTATION.calibration: Lens/distortion calibration + spatial scale + timebase sync
INSTRUMENTATION.raw: Original image sequence + calibration file + time sync record

TEST_ARTICLES.purpose: mass/CG/inertia and static property acquisition fixture
TEST_ARTICLES.evidence: physical mass properties of exact configuration

TEST_ARTICLES.variable: one module at a time, then best documented combination
TEST_ARTICLES.evidence: translation, load sharing, rotation control, rebound, integrated dynamics

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The assembled mechanism can be measured, inspected and reset repeatedly without hidden interference.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Dimensional/clearance verification, datum survey, end-stop and sensor routing check.
TEST_MATRIX.output: Inspection report, clearance map, as-built configuration
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: No uncontrolled interference; all critical interfaces positively retained; deviations logged.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The intended translation DOF exists and is repeatable under manual/mechanical actuation.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Demonstrate guided travel, lock states, stop engagement and reset.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Manual or controlled low-force actuation within safe envelope
TEST_MATRIX.output: Travel x(t), state sequence, interference observations
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Continuous guided motion through intended envelope; no binding or unintended release.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The bilateral rails carry repeatable reactions without pathological load asymmetry caused by installation.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Incremental controlled load; exact ceiling set after fixture proof review
TEST_MATRIX.boundary: Base fixed; carriage constrained to intended DOF
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Response is repeatable and within pre-approved fixture/load limits; unexplained asymmetry triggers inspection.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Each structurally relevant sliding/contact interface has a measurable configuration-specific friction law.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Identify static/kinetic friction under P0 surface state.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Controlled normal preload and sliding motion
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Repeatable identification with uncertainty and no fixture slip/secondary contact.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Mechanical stops/contact pairs have identifiable force-displacement behavior in the operating region.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Controlled compression/impact below fixture proof limit
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Stable configuration-specific law with stated validity range; no extrapolated closure.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Mechanical contact damping is measurable and separable from structural compliance.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Identify damping for selected contact pair.
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Repeatable damping identification over tested range.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Restitution/rebound of the selected stop/contact pair is measurable and controllable.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Identify rebound ratio versus approach condition.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Controlled impact velocities established by pre-test setup qualification
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Valid runs free of fixture motion and secondary impacts.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The selected absorber cartridge produces a reproducible force-stroke relation.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Measure F-x, hysteresis and end behavior.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Quasi-static and controlled dynamic profiles within verified fixture capacity
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Curve traceable to exact cartridge serial/configuration; no generic curve substitution.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The absorber response depends measurably on stroke rate within the intended operating domain.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Defined rate sweep inside qualified equipment envelope
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: No fit used outside measured domain; repeatable trends.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Temperature alters absorber response and must be retained as a configuration variable where relevant.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Same mechanical profile at controlled temperatures
TEST_MATRIX.boundary: Thermal soak and safe temperature limits
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Temperature state verified before each run; no inferred values between tested conditions without model disclosure.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Joint/fastener stiffness and preload measurably affect system compliance.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Identify joint stiffness and preload sensitivity.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Controlled axial/shear excitation and preload states
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Fixture compliance separated or quantified; exact fastener stack recorded.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Rotation-control joints have measurable clearance, friction and elastic compliance.
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Repeatable joint map; left/right differences retained.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: 170 can transition between intended mechanical states repeatedly without unintended release.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Exercise normal -> armed/capture -> ride-down/release -> rebound/end states as implemented.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Controlled trigger/force/acceleration surrogate, not a crash pulse
TEST_MATRIX.boundary: Restraint path not relied upon for human safety; no occupant
TEST_MATRIX.output: State timeline, trigger threshold/latency, release cases
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Intended transition repeatable; all unintended release/fault cases recorded.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The integrated carriage translates through the intended guided path without binding.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Integrated low-load translation and stop test.
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: No binding/jam; stop engagement reproducible; any damage triggers teardown.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Seatback rotation-control remains mechanically distinct from longitudinal energy path.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Test 150L/150R while longitudinal carriage motion is separately controlled/isolated.
TEST_MATRIX.boundary: Carriage locked for isolation test, then repeat with translation permitted
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Measurable distinct reaction path and no unintended coupling beyond documented joint compliance.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The rebound-control module measurably limits reverse travel after primary translation.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Controlled release/return from bounded primary stroke
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Reverse motion remains bounded and controlled; no uncontrolled return or secondary interference.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Changing one controlled design variable changes the measured mechanism response in the expected direction without confounding from other changes.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: A/B comparison using one-variable-at-a-time variant rule.
TEST_MATRIX.output: paired response metrics and effect estimate
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: Configuration, serial, setup and calibration matched; otherwise mark MULTIVARIABLE COMPARISON.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: The integrated mechanism can repeat controlled dynamic events while preserving traceable state, force, displacement and rotation measurements.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: First integrated controlled dynamic screening; no occupant.
TEST_MATRIX.load: Laboratory-controlled dynamic excitation only; vehicle pulse is not assumed
TEST_MATRIX.boundary: Containment fixture, hard stops, safe load ceiling
TEST_MATRIX.output: full synchronized DAQ + video + post-test inspection
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: All channels valid, synchronization verified, no uncontrolled release, complete evidence package.

TEST_MATRIX.hypothesis: Post-test inspection can distinguish elastic recovery from permanent change and make the article reusable or sacrificial by rule.
TEST_MATRIX.objective: Teardown, dimensional reinspection, damage classification, reset decision.
TEST_MATRIX.output: damage map, permanent deformation, replacement decision
TEST_MATRIX.criterion: No reuse without documented inspection acceptance.

VARIANT_MATRIX.name: Baseline mechanism
VARIANT_MATRIX.hypothesis: Establish reference function and measurement repeatability.
VARIANT_MATRIX.control: Fixed baseline absorber, baseline lock, baseline rebound and baseline joint stack.
VARIANT_MATRIX.single_variable: None; this is the control configuration.
VARIANT_MATRIX.change_rule: No design change during baseline campaign except safety repair that is logged separately.

VARIANT_MATRIX.name: Alternative absorber
VARIANT_MATRIX.hypothesis: Absorber characteristic is a causal driver of carriage force/displacement response.
VARIANT_MATRIX.control: All structural geometry, lock, rebound, joints and test command held constant.
VARIANT_MATRIX.change_rule: Only cartridge serial/specification changes; mounting interface remains invariant.

VARIANT_MATRIX.name: Alternative lock
VARIANT_MATRIX.hypothesis: Lock strategy changes transition timing/state robustness without changing absorber law.
VARIANT_MATRIX.control: Same absorber cartridge, rails, joints, rebound and test command.
VARIANT_MATRIX.change_rule: Only 170 is changed; any trigger hardware change must be recorded as part of the same controlled variable.

VARIANT_MATRIX.name: Alternative rebound control
VARIANT_MATRIX.hypothesis: Rebound-control strategy changes reverse excursion while primary forward path remains comparable.
VARIANT_MATRIX.control: Same absorber, lock, rail, joint and test command.

VARIANT_MATRIX.name: Integrated exploratory configuration
VARIANT_MATRIX.hypothesis: The combined architecture can operate as a coupled mechanism with measurable bilateral translation, independent rotation-control and rebound control.
VARIANT_MATRIX.control: Use the best documented preceding component options, each with provenance.
VARIANT_MATRIX.single_variable: None; this is intentionally MULTIVARIABLE and is not used for causal attribution.
VARIANT_MATRIX.change_rule: Configuration manifest freezes the exact selected components and serials before each test.

F(x,v,T) absorber and carriage force path
Rotation path compliance and load law

evidence: fixture inspection and load verification only; no occupant test in P0 early levels

CHANGE_CONTROL.rule: No physical revision may be silently substituted into an A/B comparison. Every change gets a unique revision and serial/configuration manifest.

FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.detect: displacement irregularity, rail reaction divergence, video, inspection
FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.action: Stop test, unload, inspect alignment/runner/rail; do not force through jam.

FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.detect: 170 state channel + high-speed video + carriage motion
FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.action: Immediate safe stop; isolate trigger and lock components; retain all raw data.

FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.detect: force asymmetry, lateral reaction, visual deformation
FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.action: Stop, inspect clevis/pin/fixture, repeat alignment verification before next run.

FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.detect: travel sensor, force spike, video, permanent deformation
FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.action: Hard stop test, quarantine damaged component, inspect stop/rail/carriage.
Inspect datum alignment, joint preload, rail friction and absorber match.

FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.detect: DAQ audit, channel clipping, timebase comparison, calibration checks
FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.action: Invalidate run for physical-input evidence; repair instrumentation and repeat.

FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.detect: post-test dimensional survey and strain evidence where installed
FAILURE_MODE_REGISTER.action: Classify article as sacrificial or repairable; no reuse without review.
Replace/retorque per controlled procedure; do not silently reset.

DATA_ACQUISITION.global_sync: Common DAQ timebase for force/displacement/angle/acceleration/state channels; high-speed video time-synchronized to DAQ.
DATA_ACQUISITION.raw_data_principle: Never overwrite raw data. Store original files read-only and generate reduced data as new artifacts.
reduction_principles: derive velocity only from calibrated displacement or validated inertial measurement
calculate work from measured force-displacement data
report uncertainty with every derived physical input

SAFETY.test_boundary: Bench/subsystem controlled testing only until physical evidence supports escalation.
SAFETY.load_limit: Defined from fixture proof test and component certification; not invented from source target forces.
SAFETY.failure_containment: Guarding/secondary retention around moving or potentially ejecting components.

DEV006.exact_fabrication: DEV-006-FABRICATION-EXACT remains separate and requires native CAD extraction.
DEV006.exploratory_fabrication: P0-EXPLORATORY-FABRICATION may use documented local deviations while keeping architecture and interfaces testable.
DEV006.rule: Do not label exploratory local dimensions as exact R4.1 dimensions.

PHYSICAL_INPUT_CLOSURE_BRIDGE.mass: P0-A physical measurement of exact article; CAD-derived mass remains a cross-check only.
PHYSICAL_INPUT_CLOSURE_BRIDGE.CG: P0-A balance/reaction measurement on exact article.
PHYSICAL_INPUT_CLOSURE_BRIDGE.inertia: P0-A rotational inertia fixture on exact article.
PHYSICAL_INPUT_CLOSURE_BRIDGE.density: material coupon/lot measurement or certified material data for each relevant P0 material.
PHYSICAL_INPUT_CLOSURE_BRIDGE.vehicle_pulse: external qualified sled/vehicle source; not invented by P0 bench article.
PHYSICAL_INPUT_CLOSURE_BRIDGE.initial_velocity: external test command/vehicle source with independent measurement.

MANUS_HANDOFF.no_close_rule: P0 evidence does not itself authorize R4.1 mutation or R4.2 creation. Manus validates physical evidence; Peter controls gates.
